Method of Attack: Automatically executes code during installation and compilation using Roslyn SDK APIs (DiagnosticAnalyzer and IIncrementalGenerator).

Exploitation of Roslyn SDK's DiagnosticAnalyzer and IIncrementalGenerator APIs.
